data_kind: site-specific Wireless InSite ray tracing; not over-the-air capture
dataset: DeepMIMO ASU Campus 3.5 GHz (angular ray geometry)
features_sha256_scope: Exact JSONL bytes for this build. features_sha256 is host-dependent (gains/angles rounded to 4 decimals); cross-host reproduction is verified on source_tree_sha256 plus tolerance-bounded outputs.

licensing.scenario_archive: No separate license file was present in the downloaded scenario archive; raw and row-level derived data are therefore not redistributed here.

receiver_sampling: evenly spaced over receivers with >=1 finite path
